spanish: Y el amaleqita y el cananeo habitante en el valle; mañana vuelvan faces y partan para ustedes el desierto, camino de mar de Suf.

findings.issue: פְּנוּ is only the qal imperative 2mp “turn.” The Spanish adds the noun “faces,” which no token licenses.
סוּף is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name. “Suf” leaves that lemma untranslated and treats it as a name.
בָּעֵמֶק has a preposition and an anarthrous noun. “el valle” supplies a definite article the morphology does not mark.
וּסְעוּ is qal imperative “set out,” and הַמִּדְבָּר is its destination. “partan … el desierto” can be read as dividing the wilderness.

notes: 2mp imperatives as ustedes (vuelvan, partan, ustedes) match the address; the other tokens are represented.
